description_short: An in-game to-do list: write down what is left to build, tick it off when done. Saved with your game.
description_long: To-Do List Adds a to-do list right inside the game, so you never lose track of what you were about to build. Features - Open the panel from the toolbar button, or with F8. - Type a task and press Enter to add it. - Tick a task off: it moves to a collapsible Done section instead of cluttering your list. - Clear the whole Done list in one click when it gets long. - Reorder tasks with the up and down arrows. Right-click an arrow to send a task straight to the top or the bottom. - Edit a task later: hover it, click the pencil, type the new text and press Enter. - Delete a task you no longer need. Link a task to a building Select a building, click the link icon on a task, and a gold pin appears. Click that pin later and the camera flies there with the building panel open. A link to a demolished building clears itself. The window behaves like the game's own panels - Drag it by its title bar; the position is remembered. - Resize its width by dragging the right edge. - Pin it so it stays open while you work. Speaks your language English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (BR), Dutch, Polish, Czech, Russian and Ukrainian. Your list is stored in the save file, so each game keeps its own tasks. The mod can be added to or removed from an existing save at any time.
